title_en: One to four: dva or dve
card_en: One to four change with the noun's gender: en brat, ena sestra; dva brata, dve sestri; trije bratje, tri sestre; štirje bratje, štiri sestre. To count, say ena, dva, tri, štiri.

example.sl: Imam dva brata in dve sestri.
example.en: I have two brothers and two sisters.

one.m.note_en: en before a noun, eden when it stands alone.

one.f.note_en: Also the word for counting: ena, dva, tri.

three.m.note_en: After imeti, to have, it is tri: imajo tri otroke.

four.m.note_en: After imeti, to have, it is štiri: imam štiri brate.

quick_check.explain_en: Sestra is feminine, so two is dve: dve sestri sta tukaj, two sisters are here.

helper_de: German drei and vier never change. Slovenian two to four have their own masculine forms: dva, trije, štirje.
helper_en: English two never changes. Slovenian says dva for masculine nouns and dve for feminine and neuter ones.
